title: Representation-free Densities of Ratios and Powers of Stable Variables
summary: We derive representation-free densities of ratios of the positive stable random variable and obtain their Laplace/Stieltjes transforms. We state representation-free densities of occupation times (Lamperti, 1958) and Bessel process excursions (Bertoin et al., 2006) and their transforms. We also obtain simple representations of these and other densities using a known infinite series representation of the stable density.
